entry_points.text: Compat refuses wrong vendors and unsupported hosts; creation reserves host page and bitmaps with reverse cleanup; load shrinks pause window and loads AVIC.
Fault exits forward address and code with assisted bytes; CR moves need assist and validity with narrow allowed sets; debug exits gate on encryption and idle state.
Nested VM ops check permissions, map nested blocks, advance past the instruction and copy by direction; hypercalls fault unless a flush assist qualifies.
Xen entry gathers width-dependent args, records privilege, tries accelerated poll, yield, timer and send ops, else queues a userspace exit for the remainder.
Paging loader installs nested or shadow roots with encryption handling; VM init prepares confidential and pause state; destroy tears down interrupt and speculation state.

exports.text: Host toggles gate nested paging, virtual GIF and virtual NMI with frozen post-init values; low-level run preserves host state across hardware transition.
Shared x86 helpers dispatch invalid opcodes, prefer Xen then Hyper-V hypercalls, requeue only into empty slots, and drain current and guest flush requests independently.
Generic bringup orders caches, masks, irqfd, async, debug and guest memory before virtualization and device registration, with paired teardown in reverse.
VMX control helpers build forced CR0/CR4 images with paging-aware exiting, read segments via cache with usability fixes, and record EFER with mode refresh.

hazards.text: TLB erratum touches config only when the bug is present; encrypted guests skip shutdown reinit and SMM transitions to avoid touching protected state.
All-CPU flush under enlightened remote use warns and recovers; cache and per-CPU exhaustion fails out-of-memory with full teardown of prior services.
Xen access failures become fault, oversize or cross-vCPU invalid, early misconfiguration declines; abort triggers on runnable, timer, signal or unblock request.
VMCS access failures log rate-limited with neutral return; spurious faults assert reboot; nested abort triple-faults with diagnostic and no recovery.

invariants.text: Pause and halt polling adapt windows within bounds only on change with dirty mark and trace; per-VM ceiling overrides global, zero disables growth.
MSR and exception policy allows direct common accesses, mediates perf and encryption ranges, strips virtualization enable, and programs bitmaps from fixed plus dynamic faults.
VMCB init installs default plus conditional traps, programs bitmaps, segments, tables and paging controls, resets identifiers, marks dirty and enables GIF.
Bringup rejects active vendor, weak memory type or missing features, then builds caps from generic base with gated nesting and encryption and clears unsupported bits.
Xen calls follow guest width with split narrow deadlines, accelerate only at privilege zero for self timers, and map negative or overflow deadlines to short delay.
TLB invalidation retires generations or uses hardware flush, purges enlightened state first, and restricts single-address direct invalidation to shadow paging.
VMCS access dispatches on global enlightenment flag with neutral miss behavior, split wide ops on narrow hosts, and clean-marker clear on enlightened store.
Nested MSR lists walk bounded entries with validation and index-tagged failure, rejecting reserved and SMM ranges; CR3 reload validates, rebuilds MMU and reloads PAE.

locks.text: OSVW keeps minimum length and union status under spinlock, VMCB dumps serialize under mutex, and branch-mitigation count uses serialized first-create last-destroy.
Event pending tests hold sleepable plus cache locks, abort checks hold sleepable read, and port lookup uses RCU with lifetime under VM synchronization.

state_machines.text: CPU enable takes reference, refreshes generation and bounds, points firmware save and mitigations; disable restores; identifiers increase per CPU with wrap flush.
Exit handling consumes nested exits, honors fast hints else dispatches by reason, then resets markers, unmasks on progress and demultiplexes NMI, exception and soft paths.
NMI and IRQ program valid events with masking or virtual pending; SMM spills outer state with marker and restores only with support and validation.
Debug exits report status and linear PC or reinject; machine check terminates on erratum match; port I/O decodes string, direction, port and size with fast or parked paths.
Halt spin-polls while abort checks pass then sleeps interruptibly; invalid wakeups and long sleeps shrink the interval, short halts grow it with headroom.
Xen timers translate kvmclock deadlines, cancel prior arms, complete immediately when overdue else arm absolute; expiry tries fast delivery else defers with unblock.
Nested exit discards traps, services flush, syncs shadow and exit fields, switches structures, then loads ordered host state or unwinds with fixed flags on failure.

structs.text: Per-CPU SVM state holds TSC cache and save area; I/O bitmap spans three pages, MSR bitmap two, with clean mask covering low bits plus software bit.
Save area keeps segments, tables, controls and debug state; control keeps intercepts, TSC, identifiers and injection; vCPU links nested, MSR and interrupt state.
Exit info pairs 32-bit reason with 64-bit companions and validity encoding; intercept entries pair vendor codes with before, after and after-memory stages.
ABI types fix LDT and busy TSS encodings; CR intercept validity lives in the top bit of the first info word with distinct read and write trace codes.
Enlightened translation rotates encodings to slots with bounds check and revision hole; version is one and all-bits-set marks invalid pointer.
Host VMX config aggregates basic and control caps; exit reason pairs word with code and flags; entry options use low bits for resume and speculation handling.
